blocks: IIT Roorkee has released the JEE Advanced 2026 Topper List. Shubham Kumar secured AIR 1 with an outstanding score of 330 out of 360 marks.
Shubham Kumar from the IIT Delhi zone emerged as the national topper by securing AIR 1 and scoring 330 marks out of 360.
The top three rank holders are Shubham Kumar at AIR 1, Kabeer Chhillar at AIR 2, and Jatin Chahar at AIR 3.
